flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties (no warrant cron). ocmsadminui utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts (type only), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts, pages/Notice/form/NoticeOccurences.tsx, utils/config/env.ts. ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/warrantofarrest). No entity, repository, controller, or job for a WA database in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi
note: The story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given), so it is traced normally. The story asks for a database of IDs with outstanding warrants of arrest, kept daily by add/remove criteria and holding notice/summons numbers, notice type, warrant details, record creation date, past visits and address visited. No code exists for this: no cron/job in cron-schedules-prod.properties, no entity or WA table in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi, and the address visited field appears in no repo. The only traces are the TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40), which has warrant_no, summon_no, notice_no, cre_date but no visit fields and no backend, and the UI component NoticeOccurences (fields date_of_visit, visit_flag at NoticeOccurences.tsx:230-241), which is not mounted because its tab is commented out (Form.tsx:219-226; GroupPreview.tsx:127-132) and has no backend. The UI calls resource warrantofarrest (useSearch.ts:74) and only /v1/warrantofarrest appears in api-authorization.properties:23; its controller is not in any repo, so the WA table is probably managed outside this repo (cannot verify from repo). No relevant maintenance ticket (grep warrant, work order, visit, tagging: 0 hits).
recommendation: No code in the repo for a daily WA database; do not claim as done. Ask the team whether this was built in another repo/system (RoMS, service provider) or mark as a gap

steps.step: A daily job runs to maintain the database of IDs with outstanding warrants of arrest
steps.detail: cron-schedules-prod.properties only holds other crons (for example cron.dailyreport:255-257, the generic Daily Report Job); there is no warrant/WA cron, job, or service entry. case-insensitive grep across the six repos (warrant, workorder, work_order, tagging, visit, enforcement, bailiff, service provider, matrix) finds no entity, controller, cron, or service for this feature. The cronservice/ folder at the repo root is a stale copy and is not used.

steps.step: Cases are added to the database based on pre-defined criteria
steps.detail: No rule, query, or service selects notices with an outstanding warrant and stores them as new records. The only trace of warrant data is the TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40) in ocmsadminui; ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi have no WA entity/repository.

steps.step: Cases are removed from the database when the removal criteria are met
steps.detail: No removal logic: no code detects a cancelled/paid/executed warrant and takes the ID off a list. case-insensitive grep across the six repos (warrant, workorder, work_order, tagging, visit, enforcement, bailiff, service provider, matrix) finds no entity, controller, cron, or service for this feature.

steps.step: Each record holds notice/summons numbers, notice type, warrant details, record creation date, past visits and address visited
steps.detail: The type Iwarrantofarrest (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40) has notice_no, summon_no, warrant_no, warrant_type, warrant_issue_date, cre_date, but it is only a type declaration in the UI; there is no backend entity/table and no address visited field in any repo. Past visits appear only as date_of_visit and visit_flag in the NoticeOccurences component (NoticeOccurences.tsx:230-241), which is not mounted (tab commented out, Form.tsx:219-226) and has no backend. Notice type lives on the notice data, not on a WA record.

steps.step: The Tagging officer opens and browses the list of IDs with outstanding warrants in the staff portal
steps.detail: There is no WA list menu/route. The closest is the per-notice Notice Occurrences component (NoticeOccurences.tsx), but its tab is commented out in Form.tsx:219-226 and GroupPreview.tsx:127-132 so it is not displayed; its resource offencenoticeoccurrences is also only set when isAPIFound = STAGING or LOCAL (NoticeOccurences.tsx:69; env.ts:11) and no controller for it exists in any repo. The component lists occurrences of one notice, not WA IDs. The real server ENV value cannot be verified from the repo.
